title: 第2566章 你是我第2565章 你怎么没死啊
slug: 灵气复苏我有个吞噬系统
content_zh:
在这火辣女子的视角看来，丘凌风就是站在原地不动，对面的那个熔岩身影就直接死了。
这种情况唯一的解释就是丘凌风也是超能者了。
“你知道我是超能者的话，难道不害怕嘛？”
丘凌风看着又凑上来的火辣女子，有些疑惑的问道。
从刚才的火辣女子的反应来看，分明是惧怕超能者力量的。
但是在自己展示了能力后，她非但没有害怕，反而还走过来了。
难不成。
现在这个时空里，地球上的人们都适应了超能者的存在？
早就见怪不怪了？
“我们害怕的只是刚才那种破坏者呀？帅哥，你该不会刚成为超能者吧？不过你这打扮真是奇怪，一身古风打扮还对超能者的事情所知甚少，难不成你是隐世门派的？”
火辣女子挠了挠头，开始猜测起了丘凌风的身份。
听着火辣女子的这一番话，丘凌风微微皱眉，开始回忆起了灵链中的传承记忆。
艾特斯亚的异能科技，与地球本土的战斗体系。
像海棠国这边就是内外古武功法，除此之外，别国还有狼人、吸血鬼、天使、萨满、元素者、忍者之类的战斗体系。
“在这个时空里，我的身份是地球反抗联盟盟主，海棠隐世势力联盟盟主，艾特斯亚千星阁阁主。”
丘凌风整理了一番脑海中的记忆，目光一凝。
“我该走了，告辞。”
丘凌风朝着那火辣女子抱了抱拳，然后纵身一跃，跳上高空，直接化作遁光，破空而去。
“诶诶，帅哥！你真是超能者啊？”
那火辣女子还站在原地，怔怔的看着丘凌风已经化成小点的背影，挥手大喊起来。

片刻后，广场的骚乱平息。
维护城市治安的治安队成员抵达现场，登记了此次骚乱的各种信息。
另一边的丘凌风，已经回到了记忆里那个熟悉的城市。
“嗯，这么多年过去了，变化是有的，但是大部分地方还是没什么变化。”
丘凌风远远地观察着不远处的现代化城市，心中思绪万千。
下一刻，丘凌风就感觉到自己的气息被锁定了。
而后数十道身影从城市上空朝着自己这里飞来。
“新城境内，未经许可禁止飞行。”
“前方可疑人员立即表明身份，否则我方有权将你当场击毙！”
一个背后长着白色羽翼的战斗人员张口喊道，开口之时，还带着滚滚音浪。
除此之外，其他身影同样表情严肃。
只是，当他们看清楚丘凌风的脸时，表情齐刷刷的愣了一下。
“阁主？”
为首的那个羽翼青年看着丘凌风，试探性的开口。
“不对，他不是阁主！”
另一人手中出现了斩刀，滋啦一声，电流便覆盖在了刀面上。
“所有人小心，此人极可能是拥有伪装异能的超能者！”
第二人大声提醒了在场的所有人。
content_en:
From the perspective of this hot woman, Qiu Lingfeng just stood there, while the lava figure opposite him died.
The only explanation for this situation is that Qiu Lingfeng is also a superpower.
"If you knew I was a superpower, wouldn't you be afraid?"
Qiu Lingfeng asked with some doubts as he looked at the hot woman approaching again.
Judging from the reaction of the hot woman just now, it is clear that she is afraid of the power of superpowers.
But after she showed her ability, instead of being afraid, she actually came over.
Is it possible?
In this current time and space, people on earth have adapted to the existence of superpowers?
Are you used to it a long time ago?
"Are we only afraid of the kind of destroyers just now? Handsome man, you have just become a superpower, right? But your dress is really strange. You are dressed in an ancient style and you know very little about superpowers. Could it be that you are from a secluded sect?"
The hot woman scratched her head and began to guess Qiu Lingfeng's identity.
Listening to the hot woman's words, Qiu Lingfeng frowned slightly and began to recall the inherited memories in the spirit chain.
Aitesia's supernatural technology and the Earth's native fighting system.
For example, Haitang Country has ancient internal and external martial arts. In addition, other countries also have fighting systems such as werewolves, vampires, angels, shamans, elementalists, and ninjas.
"In this time and space, my identity is the leader of the Earth Resistance Alliance, the leader of the Haitang Hidden World Alliance, and the leader of the Atesya Thousand Stars Pavilion."
Qiu Lingfeng sorted out the memories in his mind and focused his eyes.
"It's time for me to go and say goodbye."
Qiu Lingfeng clasped his fists at the hot woman, then jumped up into the sky, turned into an escaping light, and flew away through the air.
"Hey, handsome guy! Are you really a superpower?"
The hot woman was still standing there, staring blankly at Qiu Lingfeng's back that had turned into a dot, waving her hands and shouting.
After a while, the commotion in the square subsided.
Members of the security team who maintain law and order in the city arrived at the scene and registered various information about the riot.
Qiu Lingfeng on the other side has returned to the familiar city in his memory.
"Well, after so many years, there have been changes, but most places remain unchanged."
Qiu Lingfeng observed the modern city not far away from a distance, with many thoughts in his mind.
The next moment, Qiu Lingfeng felt that his breath was locked.
Then dozens of figures flew towards him from the sky above the city.
"Flying within the new city is prohibited without permission."
"The suspicious person in front will identify himself immediately, otherwise we have the right to kill you on the spot!"
A combatant with white wings on his back opened his mouth and shouted, and when he spoke, there was a roaring sound.
In addition, other figures also have serious expressions.
However, when they saw Qiu Lingfeng's face clearly, their expressions were all stunned for a moment.
"Pavilion Master?"
The leading young man with wings looked at Qiu Lingfeng and spoke tentatively.
"No, he is not the Pavilion Master!"
A chopping knife appeared in the other person's hand, and with a sizzle, electric current covered the surface of the knife.
"Everyone, be careful. This person is most likely a superpower with disguised powers!"
The second person loudly reminded everyone present.
